mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.article_title AS title, a.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, a.publish_time AS publishTime, a.view_count AS viewCount, a.like_count AS likeCount FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.status = 1
